message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"COMPOSITION_CONCURRENCY","label":"C","source_lines":[5,6,12,20,28,38],"reason":"The SPEC's SERIAL/L0 structure is implemented: LEFT deposit phase, then RIGHT deposit phase, then LEFT consume phase, then RIGHT consume phase, all in one run_task coroutine without joined worker coroutines."},{"id":"EXCHANGE_PROTOCOL","label":"C","source_lines":[18,26,30,36,39,45],"reason":"Each arm deposits/clears its own pad, signals its own item-bound ready event, waits for peer ready before consuming, and clears the peer event after the receipt-carrying target move."},{"id":"EXCHANGE_RECEIPT","label":"C","source_lines":[30,33,36,39,42,45],"reason":"LEFT passes left_wait_receipt from wait_event(\"right_ready\") into move(\"LEFT\",\"left_target\",receipt=...) and clears right_ready with that receipt's version; RIGHT symmetrically uses right_wait_receipt for left_ready."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"V","source_lines":[16,17,24,25,34,35,43,44],"reason":"Each release is followed by a same-arm move, but the SPEC requires the immediate separating move to start in the same candidate coroutine and same virtual time; the source shows sequential awaited calls with no evidence of same-virtual-time start, and the required immediate departure after release is not established."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"C","source_lines":[13,14,15,16,17,18,21,22,23,24,25,26,30,31,32,33,34,35,36,39,40,41,42,43,44,45],"reason":"The code deposits left_part on left_pad and right_part on right_pad, then LEFT carries right_part to left_target and RIGHT carries left_part to right_target, ending at left_depart/right_depart with both ready events cleared."}]}
